single_variable: With a fixed 1.25x midpoint on the identical native Binance portfolio, compare uniform 1.25x to a +/−0.25x ETH/BTC conditional tilt and its reverse. The higher 1.5x midpoint has an unresolved AIOT mark-and-stop tie in one minute, so that uniform control has no reportable capital curve. Require native 1m mark and trade ordering and report exact matched outcomes; same parents, 1000U, slippage, capacity assumptions.
